idea-plugin.name: Pax
idea-plugin.description:
A minimalist dark theme using comfortable UI colors, built on top of the Islands look introduced in JetBrains IDEs 2025.3.

Developed on top of the Carbon theme by Luis Fernando Jiménez.

  • Islands UI by default — rounded editor and tool window panels.
  • JetBrains Mono as the default editor and console font, ligatures on.
  • Completely italic-free syntax highlighting.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • Initial release of the Pax theme.
  • Dark theme built on the Islands UI (Islands Dark parent theme) for JetBrains 2025.3+.
  • Color palette inherited from the Carbon theme by Luis Fernando Jiménez.
  • JetBrains Mono as the default editor and console font.
  • Italic-free syntax highlighting.
